# `ext::https_batch` — declaration reference

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/https_batch.lani#L2)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Thin verified HTTPS factory/driver adapter over the single generic HTTP batch engine. Jobs borrow numeric endpoints, certificate identities and HTTP Requests; job/context backing remains unchanged through return. All HTTP requests prepare before sockets; per-job TLS option/identity admission and native verification occur later. Typed results preserve complete HTTPS diagnostics, input order, response ownership and partial outcomes. OpenSSL performs TLS and cryptography; callers establish SIGPIPE policy, and TLS 1.2/1.3 retry/closure scope follows https_client. All six connected groups pass 108 cases through three Linux x86_64/glibc/OpenSSL 3 receipts, including 42 reached source-allocation failures and six direct-step/abort controls. Plain batch separately passes eight groups/103 cases. The migrated HTTPS fetch passes four app groups/63 cases, and mutual-TLS application modes pass three groups/101 cases excluding prepared-context streams. Historical and current receipt scopes remain distinct; worker/server orchestration remains open.
